batch_assignment: Deterministic longest(agent+verifier native seconds) task first; assign to lowest accumulated-budget batch, then lowest batch index. Not based on successes.
client_and_server_generation_parameters: Unchanged from locked measurement-rules.json except per-batch server seed explicitly above.
model_service: One vLLM process per batch; sequential native Harbor single-task jobs with4 independent clean trials each. No added agent loop or scheduler.
reason: Observed gh-dev MaxJobsPU=1 and queue delay; user authorized longer gh allocations under CLAUDE.md exception.
seed_policy: A single deterministic server_seed per new batch, derived from scheduling amendment hash, population hash and sorted-budget batch membership/index before requests. Continuous RNG stream across independent Harbor trials; historical per-job seeds/results preserved. New scheduling/seed identity is recorded and is not claimed bit-identical to unstarted historical plans.
timeout_limit_caveat: This is an overhead allowance, not a guarantee that all setup/collect timeout caps can simultaneously be consumed. Full serial phase caps exceed8x48hours; no cap is shortened. Allocation interruptions stay unresolved, not model failures, and require explicit follow-up reconciliation.
user_authorization: User explicitly requested6–8 parallel gh batches after gh-dev serial-job queue made measurement take1–2weeks; retain completed attempts and cancel only not-started jobs.
walltime_basis: Sum of native agent+verifier budgets plus at least6hours for setup/capture/model startup. Every batch requests the QOS maximum48hours and exits as soon as done.
